About Us

UNIGENS is a Romanian software development company, activating in the gambling industry, offering integrated management solutions for companies in the field (B2B). Our company operates with a Class-II type license issued by ONJN more than 10 years ago and our clients are both local (Romania) as well as international. The 360 R/Evolution Platform is the main product UNIGENS is developing. It includes a wide array of features and applications which cover the entire spectrum of activities that a gambling operator requires.


YOU will experience our working environment where you will have:
- Ability to learn new things
- Interaction with young and enthusiastic team
- Working in cool, interesting and international projects
- Professional challenges
- Overall personal development
- to work on-site, full time

and expect 10.000 RON NET, including a 3 month probation period


For all these, YOU, as an experienced Front End developer, will have to:
- Translate UI/UX design wireframes into actual code to produce visual elements of the application.
- Optimize web pages for maximum speed and scalability across various devices and browsers.
- Implement responsive design to ensure the web application works well on a variety of devices and screen sizes.
- Write reusable code and libraries for future use, promoting maintainability and efficiency.
- Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate web interfaces with server-side logic and functionality.
- Manage SEO principles to ensure the website has a strong digital presence.
- Monitor website performance, assessing analytics, and refining the front-end code accordingly.


YOUR Personal Skills and Technical Expertise, as an experienced Front End developer, on:
- Attention to detail, organized, communicative, reliable, positive attitude
- HTML, CSS, and JavaScript + familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Vue.js, React and Angular
- Version Control Systems like Git
- design and a deep understanding of user experience principles so that users can navigate and interact with the site or application with ease
- Understanding responsive design frameworks, implementing media queries to guarantee a consistent user experience
- Optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript files, and leveraging browser caching
- Knowledge of performance metrics and tools like Google's Lighthouse


Looking forward to hearing from you,

Have an amazing day!
